methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This paper gives an insight into how energy management is implemented in Serbian manufacturing

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Questionnaire-based maturity/implementation assessment of ISO 50001 energy management practices across 52 organisations, scored by PDCA cycle. The paper does not present, propose, evaluate, or critique an EnPI/EnB measurement model: energy indicators and energy baseline appear only incidentally as survey categories, with no model variables, functional form, or construction/estimation approach characterised.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The results were used to calculate the energy management implementation level.

stage1.notes: Cross-sectional questionnaire survey of 52 Serbian manufacturers (food, non-metallic minerals) scoring ISO 50001 EnMS implementation level via PDCA. Assessment-tool/maturity framing; no EnPI/EnB measurement model characterised. paper_type could alternatively read as 'other' (empirical survey).
